roadmap.subtitle: Where we came from, and where the next six months go.
roadmap.q1Description: Core contracts, five-agent prototype, and the ZK pipeline we ended up rebuilding twice.
roadmap.q2Description: Pool + seven agents live on SUI mainnet. A withdrawal bug got caught the hard way. We shipped v0.2.0 to fix it.
roadmap.q3Description: Autonomy defense (eight gates). Rebuilt the trader's sizing after a rough drawdown. Aiven → self-hosted Bakchodi database.
roadmap.q4Description: External audit through the SUI Foundation grant. Move the AdminCap to a multisig. Raise the deposit cap only after each step survives a real drawdown test.
